title: E-Commerce Manager
description:
**E\-commerce Manager**

**Company:** Angroos Gifts Boutique

**Location:** Kadavanthra, Kochi, Kerala

**Job Type:** Full\-Time

**Salary:** **₹15,000 – ₹22,000 per month** \+ Performance Incentives

**Work Mode:** In Person

**About the Role**

Angroos Gifts Boutique is looking for a smart, technology\-friendly, and detail\-oriented **E\-commerce Manager** to manage our e\-commerce website, online orders, digital inventory, product listings, and day\-to\-day online store operations.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with technology and have basic knowledge of **SEO, digital marketing, AI tools, e\-commerce operations, and online inventory management**.

This role is suitable for someone who enjoys managing an online business and taking responsibility for keeping the website, products, stock, orders, and customer information accurate and up to date.

**Key Responsibilities**

**E\-commerce Website Management**

* Manage the day\-to\-day operations of the Angroos e\-commerce website.
* Add and update products, categories, prices, descriptions, specifications, and images.
* Ensure all product information displayed on the website is accurate.
* Update banners, offers, collections, and seasonal products when required.
* Monitor the website regularly and identify errors, broken pages, incorrect information, or other issues.
* Coordinate with the development team for technical website issues and improvements.
* Ensure new products are published on time.

**Online Order Management**

* Monitor and process online orders.
* Verify customer, product, payment, and delivery information.
* Update order status accurately at each stage.
* Coordinate with packing, accounts, inventory, and delivery teams.
* Ensure customers receive proper order and delivery updates.
* Follow up on delayed, pending, cancelled, or incomplete orders.
* Maintain accurate online order records.

**Digital Inventory Management**

* Maintain and update digital inventory regularly.
* Ensure website stock matches actual available inventory.
* Update out\-of\-stock and restocked products promptly.
* Monitor fast\-moving and low\-stock products.
* Coordinate with the store, purchase, and inventory teams for stock updates.
* Avoid overselling caused by incorrect online inventory.
* Maintain accurate product SKUs, variants, quantities, and pricing.

**SEO \& Website Performance**

* Perform basic SEO for products, categories, and website pages.
* Create SEO\-friendly product titles, descriptions, meta titles, and meta descriptions.
* Conduct basic keyword research.
* Monitor website visibility through Google Search Console and other available tools.
* Identify opportunities to improve organic website traffic.
* Coordinate with the SEO or marketing team for advanced optimization when required.

**Digital Marketing Support**

* Support online promotions, seasonal campaigns, offers, and product launches.
* Coordinate with the digital marketing and social media teams.
* Assist with website landing pages and campaign\-related product updates.
* Understand basic Google, Meta, social media, and digital marketing concepts.
* Monitor which products and categories are performing well online.

**Product Content \& Photography**

* Coordinate product photography and content requirements.
* Take clean product photos and short videos using a smartphone when required.
* Edit/crop basic product images for website use.
* Ensure website product images are clear, attractive, and properly organized.
* Coordinate with photographers, designers, and content creators when professional content is required.

**AI \& Technology**

* Use **AI tools such as ChatGPT** and other productivity tools to improve product descriptions, SEO content, research, and day\-to\-day work.
* Explore new AI and technology tools that can improve e\-commerce efficiency.
* Be comfortable learning new software, dashboards, and online tools.
* Suggest technology\-based improvements for website and e\-commerce operations.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent qualification.
* Basic knowledge of **e\-commerce website management**.
* Basic understanding of **SEO and Digital Marketing**.
* Good computer and internet skills.
* Comfortable working with AI tools and modern technology.
* Understanding of online orders and digital inventory management.
* Basic smartphone photography and video skills.
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Office / Google Workspace.
* Good communication skills in Malayalam and English.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and take responsibility for daily website operations.
* Experience with WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, or another e\-commerce platform is an advantage.
* Freshers with strong technical knowledge and relevant skills may also apply.

**Skills Preferred**

* E\-commerce Management
* Digital Inventory Management
* SEO
* Digital Marketing
* AI Tools
* Website Management
* Product Listing \& Optimization
* Google Search Console
* Basic Analytics
* Smartphone Product Photography
* Basic Video Shooting
* Content Management
* Technology \& Problem Solving

**Benefits**

* Performance\-Based Incentives
* Hands\-on Experience Managing a Growing E\-commerce Business
* Career Growth Opportunities
* Professional Training \& Skill Development
* Exposure to SEO, Digital Marketing, AI \& E\-commerce Technologies
* Friendly and Professional Work Environment

**Schedule**

* Full\-Time
* Day Shift
* Monday to Saturday

**Work Location**

**Angroos Gifts Boutique**

Kadavanthra, Kochi, Kerala

**Work Mode: In Person**

**How to Apply**

**Please apply through Indeed with your updated resume.**

**Application Questions**

* Do you have experience managing an e\-commerce website?
* Do you have basic knowledge of SEO and digital marketing?
* Have you worked with digital inventory or online order management?
* Are you familiar with AI tools such as ChatGPT?
* Are you comfortable taking basic product photos and videos using a smartphone?
* Which e\-commerce platforms have you worked with?
* What is your current and expected salary?
* What is your earliest joining date?

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Content Creator Intern
description:
Content Creator Intern

**Company:** PRAVASI SOUQ  
**Department:** Marketing / Digital Marketing  
**Position:** Content Creator Intern  
**Employment Type:** Internship  
**Work Location:** Onsite – Shop / Showroom  
**Duration:** 3 Months  
**Reports To:** Marketing Manager / Content Lead

Job Summary

We are looking for a creative and energetic **Content Creator Intern** to create engaging content for Pravasi Souq's social media platforms. The intern will be involved in product photography, videography, Reels, promotional content, and day\-to\-day social media activities.

Key Responsibilities

* Create engaging **Instagram Reels, videos, photos, and social media content**.
* Shoot product videos and photographs for marketing and promotional purposes.
* Create short\-form content highlighting products, offers, new arrivals, and promotions.
* Assist in planning and developing creative content ideas.
* Handle basic **mobile photography and videography**.
* Edit videos using tools such as **CapCut, VN, Canva, Premiere Pro, or similar software**.
* Create content suitable for Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, and other digital platforms.
* Assist with product styling, setup, and presentation during shoots.
* Follow current social media trends and suggest new content ideas.
* Collaborate with the marketing and sales teams to understand promotional requirements.
* Maintain a regular content schedule and complete assigned content on time.
* Support promotional campaigns, seasonal campaigns, and special offers.
* Ensure content follows the company's branding and quality standards.

Requirements

* Students or freshers pursuing/completed **Degree, Diploma, or relevant courses** in Marketing, Media, Design, Communication, or related fields.
* Good creativity and interest in **social media and content creation**.
* Basic knowledge of photography and videography.
* Comfortable appearing in videos is an advantage.
* Basic video editing skills are preferred.
* Knowledge of **Canva / CapCut / Premiere Pro** is an advantage.
* Good communication skills.
* Willingness to learn and experiment with new content ideas.
* Ability to work **onsite at the shop/showroom**.

What You Will Gain

* Practical experience in **retail content creation and digital marketing**.
* Hands\-on experience in product photography and videography.
* Experience creating social media Reels and promotional campaigns.
* Opportunity to build a professional **content creation portfolio**.
* Internship certificate upon successful completion.
* **Stipend provided**.

Key Performance Indicators (KPI)

* Content Quality
* Reels \& Video Production
* Creativity \& New Ideas
* Content Consistency
* Video Editing Quality
* Product Presentation
* Social Media Trend Awareness
* Timely Completion of Content
* Teamwork \& Coordination
* Engagement \& Content Performance

Pay: ₹5,000\.00 \- ₹12,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Provident Fund

title: Branch Manager
description:
Key Responsibilities

* Manage the overall investment activities and day\-to\-day operations of the branch.
* Achieve monthly and annual investment mobilization targets assigned to the branch.
* Generate new business through customer acquisition, referrals, field visits, and networking.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective investors.
* Explain the company's investment products, benefits, terms, and procedures to customers.
* Identify potential investors and develop new business opportunities.
* Lead, monitor, and motivate the investment team to achieve individual and branch targets.
* Review daily customer visits, lead generation, follow\-ups, and conversions.
* Ensure timely follow\-up with prospective customers and maintain proper customer records.
* Monitor investment renewals, maturity follow\-ups, and customer retention.
* Handle customer queries, concerns, and complaints professionally and ensure timely resolution.
* Ensure all investment\-related documentation is complete and maintained properly.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and applicable guidelines.
* Conduct regular team meetings and review branch performance.
* Coordinate with the Area Manager, Regional Manager, Accounts, HR, and other departments.
* Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly investment reports.
* Monitor staff attendance, discipline, performance, and productivity.
* Ensure proper use and safeguarding of company assets.
* Support promotional activities, campaigns, and local marketing initiatives.

Key Performance Areas (KRA)

* Investment Mobilization
* New Customer Acquisition
* Customer Retention \& Renewal
* Branch Target Achievement
* Lead Generation \& Conversion
* Team Productivity
* Customer Relationship Management
* Documentation \& Compliance
* Branch Operations \& Reporting

Required Skills

* Strong sales and business development skills
* Customer relationship management
* Leadership and team management
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills
* Target\-oriented approach
* Networking and lead\-generation skills
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making ability
* Basic knowledge of MS Office and HRMS/CRM systems
* Ability to work under pressure and meet targets

Pay: ₹14,543\.49 \- ₹48,696\.44 per month

Work Location: In person
